name: The Levites
overview: The Levites were divinely appointed to serve in the tabernacle and were uniquely set apart to receive the tithes of Israel as their inheritance, reflecting their dedicated role in God's service (Numbers 18:21). They were also commanded to offer a portion of these tithes back to the Lord, highlighting their responsibility in stewarding God's provision (Numbers 18:26). The Levites, alongside the priests, managed the sacred storehouse, ensuring that the offerings were brought to God's house (Nehemiah 10:38). This system of tithing and service points forward to the coming Messiah who would purify and restore true worship in the temple, as promised in Malachi 3:1 and 3:10.
